name: Wine
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Runs a Windows-only server with Wine, from files you upload or a download link. Choose the program to start and any Winetricks it needs.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Wine. Downloads and unpacks a Windows server's files from a link, if one
# is set; otherwise the files are uploaded by hand. Unpacking adds and
# replaces the archive's own files only: nothing else is deleted.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "No download link set: upload the server's files, then set its program and start it."
    exit 0
fi
case "$DOWNLOAD_URL" in https://* | http://*) ;; *) fail "The download link must start with https:// or http://." ;; esac
dir="${INSTALL_DIR:-.}"
case "$dir" in /* | *..*) fail "The install folder must be inside the server's folder." ;; esac
mkdir -p "$dir"

build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
name="${DOWNLOAD_URL%%\?*}"
name="${name##*/}"
echo "Downloading $name"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/download" "$DOWNLOAD_URL" || fail "The download failed. Check the link, then reinstall."
case "$(file -b "$build/download")" in
Zip*) unzip -oq "$build/download" -d "$dir" ;;
gzip*) tar -xzf "$build/download" -C "$dir" ;;
XZ*) tar -xJf "$build/download" -C "$dir" ;;
bzip2*) tar -xjf "$build/download" -C "$dir" ;;
Zstandard*) tar --zstd -xf "$build/download" -C "$dir" ;;
*tar\ archive*) tar -xf "$build/download" -C "$dir" ;;
*) mv "$build/download" "$dir/${name:-download}"; echo "Saved $name as it is (not an archive)." ;;
esac
echo "Installed the files from $name."

variables.name: Program
variables.description: The Windows program that starts the server, such as Server.exe, relative to the install folder.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to the server's files (a zip or tar archive, or one file), downloaded when the server is installed. Empty to upload them yourself.

variables.name: Install folder
variables.description: A folder inside the server's folder to unpack into and start from, such as server/bin. Empty uses the server's folder.

variables.name: Winetricks
variables.description: Winetricks packages to install at start, separated by spaces, such as vcrun2019 dotnet48.

variables.name: Wine debug
variables.description: Wine's debug channels. -all keeps the console quiet.
